title: 문학관 주변 남안 추가 지붕·공간 관찰

sourceExtent.usage: Local visual reference only; do not redistribute source imagery or tiles.

method: Manually inspected the full Esri image and original-resolution crops. All pixel coordinates refer to the 1300x1000 preview; WGS84 uses exact original Web Mercator tile extent.
usage: Authored numerical observation data only. Source imagery and tiles are local reference and must not be redistributed. OSM roads/buildings and authored museum collision clearances take priority.
observations: The broad unmodelled land south/southwest of the museum is predominantly a dense low-rise neighbourhood, with narrow lanes and small planted plots, not a broad empty meadow.
A pale paved parking area lies west of the north-south museum lane.
The museum open garden extends south/southwest; separate surrounding roofs border the north and south edges.
The supplied museum GPS lies near the roof north-west edge on this image, not its apparent roof centre. Preserve the authored building unless explicitly correcting georeferencing.
Roof outlines include visual eaves/parallax. Every height, wall material and surface colour is inferred, not surveyed.
